column1: 23391§compartment§kəmˈpɑːtmənt§Passengers are advised to keep their luggage in the overhead compartment rather than leaving it in the aisle.§建议乘客把行李放在头顶上方的行李**隔间**里，不要放在过道上。§补例句
23392§apprenticeship§əˈprentɪʃɪp§A number of young people leave home to serve an apprenticeship in the factories.§许多年轻人离开家去工厂当**学徒**。§改例句：「当学徒」是 serve an apprenticeship，多了 as
23393§statutory§ˈstætʃətri§When we buy foods we have certain statutory rights.§在购买食物时，我们有一定的**法定**权利。§
23394§hygienic§haɪˈdʒiːnɪk§It isn't hygienic to let the bird stand on the dining table.§让鸟站在餐桌上是不**卫生**的。§
23395§standstill§ˈstændstɪl§Traffic was at a standstill.§交通**停滞**了。§改译文：原译「堵塞」不是 standstill（停顿，停滞）的意思，改为「停滞」
23396§erratic§ɪˈrætɪk§This clock is so erratic that it makes me late for school.§这个闹钟太**不准**了，以至于我上学都迟到了。§
23397§wicked§ˈwɪkɪd§Of course, at the end of the story, the wicked witch gets killed.§当然，**邪恶**的女巫在故事的最后被杀死了。§改例句：「在故事的结尾」是 at the end of，in 用错
23398§repercussion§ˌriːpəˈkʌʃn§The closure of the factory had serious repercussions for the whole town, where many families lost their only income.§工厂倒闭给整个小镇带来了严重的**后果**，那里许多家庭失去了唯一的收入来源。§补例句
23399§geometrical§ˌdʒiːəˈmetrɪkl§The geometrical pattern is very beautiful.§这个**几何**图案非常漂亮。§
23400§conspicuous§kənˈspɪkjuəs§One conspicuous feature of Mary's character is her independence.§玛丽性格中一个非常**显著**的特点就是独立。§改例句：指性格时 character 不用复数，characters 改为 character
23401§pivotal§ˈpɪvətl§The pivotal decision of the mayor may make a great impact on the whole city.§市长做出的**关键**决策可能对整个城市产生深远的影响。§改译文：原译「重大」不是 pivotal（关键性的）的意思，改为「关键」
23402§recurring§rɪˈkɜːrɪŋ§Some scientists believe one can control recurring bad dreams.§一些科学家认为一个人可以控制**反复**做的噩梦。§改音标：主重音符号印成了次重音 ˌ，应为 ˈ；改例句：control 作动词直接接宾语，多了 over
23403§morale§məˈrɑːl§Throughout the wilderness, post bands provided entertainment and boosted morale.§四周一片荒芜，哨所乐队提供了娱乐，鼓舞了**士气**。§
23404§retention§rɪˈtenʃn§Most people are against the retention of the nuclear weapons.§大多数人反对**持有**核武器。§

23405§allergy§ˈælədʒi§If you're not sure what's triggering your allergic cough, your doctor can give you a skin test or blood test to pinpoint the allergy.§如果你不能确定是什么引发了过敏性咳嗽，你的医师可以为你进行皮肤或血液的测试来确定**过敏**原。§
23406§conservatory§kənˈsɜːvətri§My grandmother grows tomatoes and orchids in a small conservatory attached to the back of her house.§我奶奶在房子后面连着的一间小**温室**里种番茄和兰花。§补例句
23407§sway§sweɪ§For centuries the empire held sway over much of the region, controlling its trade routes and ports.§几个世纪以来，这个帝国**统治**着该地区的大部分地方，控制着那里的贸易路线和港口。§补例句
23408§animated§ˈænɪmeɪtɪd§He became more animated.§他变得更加**活泼热情**。§
23409§overrun§ˌəʊvəˈrʌn§His speech was boring and overran the time limit.§他的演讲很枯燥并且**超过**了规定的时间。§
23410§whim§wɪm§Lisa had a sudden whim to go shopping today.§今天丽莎**一时兴起**，想要去逛街。§
23411§rectify§ˈrektɪfaɪ§Now we have a chance to rectify it, and we must take action.§现在，我们有机会**改正**它，我们必须行动起来。§
23412§outskirts§ˈaʊtskɜːts§Hours later we reached the outskirts of New York.§几个小时之后，我们到达了纽约的**郊区**。§
23413§squander§ˈskwɒndə(r)§Don't squander your time and money in reading those science fiction books.§不要把你的时间和金钱**浪费**在看那些科幻小说上。§改例句：fiction 不可数，science fictions 改为 science fiction books
23414§sweeping§ˈswiːpɪŋ§The Arts and Crafts Movement was responsible for sweeping changes in attitudes toward the decorative arts.§艺术和手工运动使人们对装饰艺术的态度**彻底**改变了。§
23415§contend§kənˈtend§The executives contend that their products appeal to diverse market segments.§管理人员**称**他们的产品满足了不同的市场需求。§
23416§liability§ˌlaɪəˈbɪləti§Since his injury, Jones has become more of a liability than an asset to the team.§琼斯负伤以来，与其说他是全队的骨干，倒不如说他已成为队里的**累赘**。§
23417§aliment§ˈælɪmənt§Fresh milk was once regarded as the most important aliment for growing children in many farming villages.§在许多农村，新鲜牛奶曾被视为成长中孩子最重要的**滋养品**。§补例句
23418§countless§ˈkaʊntləs§In the face of countless failures, he refused to quit.§面对着**无数**次的失败，他拒绝放弃。§改例句：「面对」是 in the face of，缺冠词 the
23419§rhetoric§ˈretərɪk§Students in the writing course learn how to use rhetoric to make their arguments more persuasive.§写作课上的学生学习如何运用**修辞**使论证更有说服力。§补例句
23420§venerate§ˈvenəreɪt§They venerate the image of the heroine, which is both a religious and cultural symbol.§他们把那个女英雄的形象作为宗教和文化的象征来**崇拜**。§
23421§rehearse§rɪˈhɜːs§We rehearse only one night a week.§我们一周只**排练**一晚上。§
23422§implicit§ɪmˈplɪsɪt§The doctor gave an implicit answer.§医生给出了一个**含蓄**的回答。§
23423§underlie§ˌʌndəˈlaɪ§Social problems and poverty underlie much of the crime in some big cities.§社会问题和贫穷是一些大城市中很多犯罪行为的**基础**。§
23424§prompt§prɒmpt§Bob's dislike for hot weather prompted him to move north.§鲍勃不喜欢炎热的天气，这**促使**他迁往北方。§
23425§explicit§ɪkˈsplɪsɪt§The directions Jane gave me to get to her home were very explicit.§简十分**清楚**地给我指路去她家。§
23426§molecular§məˈlekjələ(r)§The picture shows a molecular cloud.§这个图片显示的是**分子**云。§改例句：单数可数名词 cloud 前缺冠词，补 a
23427§looming§ˈluːmɪŋ§Through the thick fog, the climbers could just make out the looming shape of the mountain ahead.§透过浓雾，登山者勉强能看清前方山峰**隐隐约约**的轮廓。§补例句
23428§secrete§sɪˈkriːt§This substance is secreted from cells in the intestinal walls.§这种物质是从肠壁的细胞中**分泌**出来的。§
23429§elude§ɪˈluːd§The mice eluded the traps fortunately.§老鼠侥幸地**逃脱**了老鼠夹。§
23430§stroll§strəʊl§Jenny and her husband were strolling along, laughing and joking.§珍妮和她丈夫在悠闲地**散着步**，开心地说笑着。§改译文：错别字「他丈夫」改为「她丈夫」
23431§refurbishment§ˌriːˈfɜːbɪʃmənt§The museum will be closed for six months during the refurbishment of its main exhibition hall.§在主展厅**重新装修**期间，博物馆将闭馆六个月。§补例句
23432§observatory§əbˈzɜːvətri§A group of students will pay a visit to the ancient observatory this week.§本周，一群学生将参观这座古老的**天文台**。§
23433§stunning§ˈstʌnɪŋ§She looks absolutely stunning!§她看上去**漂亮**极了！§
23434§ceremonial§ˌserɪˈməʊniəl§The mounds served as ceremonial and trading sites, and at times they were used as burial grounds.§这片土丘用来作为举办**典礼**或者进行交易的场地，有时也被用作墓地。§
23435§immortal§ɪˈmɔːtl§Li Bai is an immortal poet.§李白是**流芳百世**的诗人。§改例句：李白的拼音应分写为 Li Bai，Libai 拼写错
23436§neural§ˈnjʊərəl§Scientists are studying how neural signals travel from the brain to the muscles when we move.§科学家正在研究我们运动时**神经**信号如何从大脑传到肌肉。§补例句
23437§bullying§ˈbʊliɪŋ§The school has introduced new rules to stop bullying, and students can now report problems to a teacher anonymously.§学校出台了制止**欺凌**行为的新规定，学生现在可以匿名向老师反映问题。§补例句
23438§ingest§ɪnˈdʒest§It is known to develop in individuals with peptic disease who ingest large amounts of calcium-carbonate-based antacids.§那些**服用**大量碳酸钙类抗酸药的人会患上消化类疾病。§

23439§bothersome§ˈbɒðəsəm§It may feel a little bothersome in the beginning, but that goes away when you start seeing how this tiny habit can affect your life.§也许这在开始时比较**麻烦**，不过当你开始看到这种小习惯能对你的人生产生影响时就不会有这种感觉了。§
23440§entangle§ɪnˈtæŋɡl§I became entangled in a lawsuit.§我**卷入**了一桩诉讼中。§
23441§cosmetics§kɒzˈmetɪks§Many cosmetics companies now avoid testing their products on animals because customers increasingly object to the practice.§由于顾客越来越反对动物实验，许多**化妆品**公司现在不再用动物测试产品。§补例句
23442§remnant§ˈremnənt§Most astronomers agree that comets are primordial remnants from the formation of the solar system.§多数天文学家认为彗星是太阳系形成时产生的原始**残余物**。§

23443§stranding§ˈstrændɪŋ§Marine biologists are investigating the stranding of over forty whales on a beach in southern Australia last week.§海洋生物学家正在调查上周四十多头鲸在澳大利亚南部一处海滩**搁浅**的事件。§改音标：双音节词漏印重音符号，补 ˈ；补例句
23444§virtual§ˈvɜːtʃuəl§Customers can design and order clothes directly from the virtual shops now.§现在，顾客可以直接从**虚拟**商店设计和定做服装。§
23445§abject§ˈæbdʒekt§Millions of families in the region still live in abject poverty, without clean water or basic health care.§该地区数以百万计的家庭仍生活在**悲惨**的贫困之中，没有清洁的饮用水和基本的医疗保健。§补例句
23446§aboriginal§ˌæbəˈrɪdʒənl§This group of aboriginal people used to live in the tribe.§这些**土著**人过去生活在部落中。§

23447§acclimatize§əˈklaɪmətaɪz§After a couple of days to acclimatize yourself, you'll start the trek on Day Three walking through the enormous Katiba Forest which will take the whole of the day.§让自己**适应**几天之后，第三天你要开始花费一整天来徒步穿越庞大的卡提巴森林。§
23448§veteran§ˈvetərən§As a veteran of twenty years in the newsroom, she trains young reporters to check every fact carefully.§作为在新闻编辑部工作了二十年的**老手**，她培训年轻记者仔细核实每一个事实。§补例句
23449§capability§ˌkeɪpəˈbɪləti§This work is beyond my capability.§这项工作超出了我的**能力**范围。§
23450§uptake§ˈʌpteɪk§Regular exercise can improve the body's uptake of oxygen and help the heart work more efficiently.§经常锻炼可以提高身体对氧气的**吸收**，帮助心脏更高效地工作。§补例句
23451§variable§ˈveəriəbl§The decision involves a large number of variables with complex relationships.§这个决定涉及很多关系复杂的**变量**。§
23452§awareness§əˈweənəs§Your awareness may be powerful enough to control your instincts.§你的**意识**也许足够强，能控制住自己的本能。§
23453§auditory§ˈɔːdətri§The car accident last year hurt the girl's auditory nerves.§去年的那场车祸使女孩的**听觉**神经受损了。§
23454§case§keɪs§Take an umbrella with you in case of rain.§带把伞吧，**以防**下雨。§
23455§dissonant§ˈdɪsənənt§The dissonant noise of car horns and drilling made it impossible to concentrate in the office.§汽车喇叭和钻机发出的**刺耳**噪音让人在办公室里根本无法集中精神。§补例句
23456§entrench§ɪnˈtrentʃ§The man entrenched himself in the business.§这个人在生意上**站住了脚**。§
23457§artistic§ɑːˈtɪstɪk§We'll see many artistic works depicting the major events of her life.§我们将看到很多描写她一生主要事件的**艺术**作品。§
23458§championship§ˈtʃæmpiənʃɪp§By a tantalizing quirk of fate, the pair have been drawn to meet in the first round of the championship.§由于命运的捉弄，这对选手被抽中在**锦标赛**的第一轮相遇。§
23459§financial§faɪˈnænʃl§The government introduced new rules to protect the financial system after several banks collapsed during the crisis.§在危机中几家银行倒闭后，政府出台了新规来保护**金融**体系。§补例句
23460§historical§hɪˈstɒrɪkl§Historical linguists study how languages evolve over time.§**历史**语言学家研究的是随着时间的流逝语言是如何演变的。§
23461§idyllic§ɪˈdɪlɪk§They spent an idyllic summer in a small village surrounded by green fields and quiet streams.§他们在一个被绿色田野和静静溪流环绕的小村庄度过了一个**闲适恬静**的夏天。§补例句
23462§agricultural§ˌæɡrɪˈkʌltʃərəl§Rising temperatures and long droughts are reducing agricultural production in many parts of Africa.§气温上升和长期干旱正在使非洲许多地区的**农业**生产减少。§补例句
23463§chronological§ˌkrɒnəˈlɒdʒɪkl§Please arrange these books on the shelf in chronological order.§请按照**年代顺序**将书架上的书整理好。§
23464§immediate§ɪˈmiːdiət§The new manager took immediate action to reduce costs after learning that the company was losing money.§新经理得知公司在亏损后，**立即**采取行动削减成本。§补例句
23465§martial§ˈmɑːʃl§After the riots, the government declared martial law and sent soldiers into the streets of the capital.§骚乱发生后，政府宣布实施**军事**管制，并派士兵进入首都街头。§补例句
23466§immerse§ɪˈmɜːs§Please immerse the vegetables in water for three minutes before washing them.§洗菜之前，先把蔬菜放在水中**浸泡**3分钟。§
23467§adept§əˈdept§Jack was adept at horse riding and enjoyed other outdoor activities.§杰克非常**精于**骑马，而且也喜欢其他户外运动。§
23468§cognitive§ˈkɒɡnətɪv§The study showed that cognitive behavioral therapy has clinical value.§研究表明，**认知**行为疗法具有一定的临床价值。§
